thread.title_full: Hegseth: 'We're Controversial Because We're over the Target'

author: akschoolmarm
text: While we 100% appreciate him, they have def NOT been good to the men and women who were forced out over COVID. They offered them a wretched deal that involved, among other ills, having to return for 4 more years of active duty in order to receive their back pay. That's extortion. They also would have to pay back all disability received between then and now. And their amount of backpay would be dependent on their income made between their separation and now. The more they made, the less they will receive. So, Jo Blow who went and sat in his mom's basement eating bonbons would get more than a guy who got up, dusted himself off, and went to work. It's a garbage deal. Furthermore, if they don't return, the only way they can be changed to honorable discharge is to get character references from the very people who kicked them out!!! So they have to prove their character??? It's all wrong. Our Marine questioned it, and the recruiter said, "Who do you think you are? You don't get to negotiate with the military! Take it or leave it!" He left it. Most are leaving it, as the trannies walk away with honorable discharges, huge severance payments, and no strings attached.
